main_text.p: Huiufmodi itaque medicamenta, fimillima funt alimentis. Humor rerum dulcium, eft aqueus, ficut in humiditate, & ficcitate; unde maturant, leniunt, emolliunt, relaxant, fed magis pinguia.

Infipidus fapor, non eft fapor; nec enim aqua, aut aliud elementum purum fapidum eft. nam fapor fuppo-nit elementorum miftionem.quæ autem obfcurum habent faporem, infipida dicuntur, ut cucurbita, cæteraque obfcurè dulcia. Caufa eft materia craffa, humore aqueo leviter perfufa, fine manifefto calore.

Notandum porrò, cum pleraque omnia medicamenta varietate partium conftent, finceros fapores raro habere, fed mixtos & confufos; qui nihilominus mixtas vires indicant. denominantur tamen ab hoc aut illo fapore, qui reliquos fuperat, & dominatur. Quod dico, manifeftum eft in aceto;quod non tantū acidum eft, fed &

page.notes: The text is set in roman type with italics not visible; the word "fed &" at the foot is the catchword-like continuation at the end of the page and is kept in the text. The cropped left margin shows partial notes of the preceding page, which are unreadable here and are omitted.
